That's really what we were able to accomplish during our time in Congress. And frankly, we're able to accomplish during our time as Secretary of Transportation, always working in a bipartisan way with Congress, with our partners, the governors, with mayors and really improving infrastructure.

We need to replenish the Highway Trust Fund if we're really going to get serious about funding big projects in America.
